description:
=== DONE (s481a) ===

CONTRIBUTING.md at the root.  Reporting a bug: the smallest program that shows
it, perl's output beside PCL's (a worked example in the file), `pcl --version`
(PCL + SBCL + PPI versions), the OS; `pl2cl bug.pl` as optional extra; and the
two files worth checking first (docs/not-supported.md, docs/STATUS.md).  Sending
a change: `tools/prove-core` (the whole gate, what CI runs), a row that fails
without the fix in an existing Pl/t file or a new <topic>-01.t, the WALL-TIME
rule for a test file, and `tools/corpus-diff.pl` with every differing file
explained in the PR (CI runs it against the PR base).  Licence paragraph: the
same terms as Perl, contributions offered under them, `tools/tag-license FILE`
for a new file.  Linked from README's Contributing section (one sentence).
subject: P3: CONTRIBUTING.md -- how to run the gate, where bugs go, and what a good report carries (one small program, run by perl and by pcl side by side)
